### E&F Currency Merge -- GENERATED FILE, DO NOT EDIT
### Rebuild with tools/regen_ef_currency_merge.py after any E&F or hotfix update.
###
### Source: E&F's company_BasicBank, cloned once per currency.
###
### WHY NINETY-FIVE COPIES OF ONE COMPANY
###
### A company produces the prestige goods on its own list, and `possible` on a
### prestige good cannot look at the country -- vanilla only ever puts
### has_dlc_feature in it. So a company can carry exactly one currency, and
### company_BasicBank is one type shared by every country that has no flavoured
### bank of its own. One type cannot mint a hundred different currencies.
###
### `potential` is the gate that does work: companies.md calls it "a trigger
### evaluated in country scope", so exactly one of these is ever visible to a
### given country -- the one matching its currency law.
###
### uses_dynamic_naming, so they come out as "Bank of <somewhere>" rather than as
### a placeholder. replaces_company is deliberately NOT copied from BasicBank: it
### points at company_basic_bank, which exists in no mod here.

zz_ef_cm_bank_dinar = {
	icon = "gfx/interface/icons/company_icons/bank/BasicBank.dds"
	background = "gfx/interface/icons/company_icons/company_backgrounds/comp_illu_manufacturing_light.dds"

	flavored_company = yes
	uses_dynamic_naming = yes

	dynamic_company_type_names = {
			"dynamic_company_type_company"
			"dynamic_company_type_consortium"
			"dynamic_company_type_corporation"
		}

	building_types = {
			building_ef_private_construction
			building_railway
			#building_port
			building_trade_center
			building_gold_mine
			building_silver_mine

			building_financial_centre
		building_bank
	}

	possible_prestige_goods = {
		zz_ef_cm_national_currency
	}

	potential = {
		OR = {
			has_law = law_type:law_dinar_currency
		}
	}

	possible = {
			any_scope_state = {
				is_incorporated = yes
				# any_scope_building = {
				# 	is_building_type = building_financial_district
				# 	level >= 1
				# }
			}
		}

	prosperity_modifier = {
			country_minting_mult = 0.075
			building_group_bg_heavy_industry_throughput_add = 0.05 #invested a lot in heavy industries, steel railways, war...

			country_loan_interest_rate_mult = -0.05
	        country_private_construction_allocation_mult = 0.05

			state_farmers_investment_pool_contribution_add = 0.01
			state_shopkeepers_investment_pool_contribution_add = 0.01
			state_clergymen_investment_pool_contribution_add = 0.04
			state_aristocrats_investment_pool_contribution_add = 0.04
			state_capitalists_investment_pool_contribution_add = 0.065

			building_nationalization_investment_return_add = 0.05
			country_government_dividends_reinvestment_add = 0.05
			country_government_dividends_efficiency_add = 0.05

			country_max_companies_add = 1
		}

	ai_will_do = {
		always = yes
	}

	ai_weight = {
		value = 3
	}
}

			building_financial_centre
		building_bank
	}

		zz_ef_cm_national_currency
	}

			has_law = law_type:law_spe_ruble_currency

		}

				is_incorporated = yes

				# }
			}
		}

	prosperity_modifier = {

			country_loan_interest_rate_mult = -0.05
	        country_private_construction_allocation_mult = 0.05

			building_nationalization_investment_return_add = 0.05
			country_government_dividends_reinvestment_add = 0.05
			country_government_dividends_efficiency_add = 0.05

			country_max_companies_add = 1
		}
